title: Meta launches Muse Image in Meta AI, Instagram, and WhatsApp, and previews Muse Video, the first media generation models from its Superintelligence Labs (Meta)
summary: Meta: Meta launches Muse Image in Meta AI, Instagram, and WhatsApp, and previews Muse Video, the first media generation models from its Superintelligence Labs — We're excited to launch Muse Image and preview Muse Video, the first media generation models developed by Meta Superintelligence Labs.
